title: New `subGauge`s can't be used by the protocol
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High, as important protocol functionality is not working  **Likelihood:** High, as the bug will happen every time  ## Description  The `createSubGauge` method in `GaugeFactory` creates a new `subGauge` but does not actually add the `subGauge` to the `GaugeProxy` as it is done in `createGaugeProxyAndSubGauges`. Even though the `GaugeProxy` contract has an `addSubGauge` method, it is only callable by the `gaugeFactory` or by the `TLSDFactory`.
